title: Using the Spotlight Tour Element in Onboarding

chapters.title: Benefits and Power of Spotlight Tours

features.name: Spotlight Tour Element
features.description: A pattern for onboarding that allows users to discover key features like Teams and Excel, with the ability to actually try features in just two steps.
caveats: Currently focused on Teams and Excel features
Requires manual page selection by developers

features.name: Two-Step Spotlight Tour Pattern
features.description: A guided experience with a first step for introduction text explaining value on the page, and a second step pointing to an action where users can try the feature.
caveats: Developers must decide which pages to use it on
Depends on relevant features being available on the page

quotes.text: Spotlight tours are a really powerful way of showing some of the key selling points in business Central such as teams and Excel
quotes.why_it_matters: Defines the core purpose and current scope of Spotlight tours as a discovery mechanism for key integrations.

quotes.text: it allows users not only to discover it but actually go and try it out with just two steps
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the key differentiator of Spotlight tours - enabling hands-on learning, not just passive discovery.

quotes.text: Spotlight tours are all about teams and Excel what is up to you to decide is on which Pages you want to call out
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies current feature scope and emphasizes developer control over where Spotlight tours appear.

quotes.text: when you're at a new place it's sometimes a little difficult to know where you are so give a little hand there and introduce
quotes.why_it_matters: Provides design guidance on using introduction text to orient new users to their current location.

quotes.text: about pointing uh to that action where the user can go and try it out to learn more
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes the second step mechanics of guiding users to actionable features for hands-on learning.
